name: ppt-svg
description: Create source-grounded SVG diagrams and complete PPTX presentations with two interoperable skills.

interface.longDescription: Two interoperable skills for turning supplied source material into a single SVG diagram or a complete PPTX deck. Both workflows preserve source facts, short verbatim excerpts, and reusable uploaded images.
defaultPrompt: Use $svg to turn this source into one clear flowchart.
Use $ppt to turn these files into a complete presentation.
Use $ppt and $svg together for a source-grounded visual deck.
